idea-plugin.name: DocBlock AI
idea-plugin.description:
Generate AI-powered documentation comments for the selected code using OpenAI or Anthropic Claude.
Supports PHPDoc, JSDoc, TSDoc, Javadoc, KDoc, Google-style Python docstrings, GoDoc, YARD, Rust doc comments, and XML doc comments (C#).

Select a function, method, class, or variable → right-click → Generate DocBlock (or use Alt+Insert → Generate DocBlock).
Configure your API key and preferred provider in Settings → Tools → DocBlock AI.

action.description: Generate AI documentation for the selected code element
